description_en: Queries the operation logs of Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium (the Chinese mainland)
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（中国内地）的操作日志
name: DescribeOpEntities

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the operation object used to filter results. Valid values:

1: IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
2: Anti-DDoS Pro and Anti-DDoS Premium mitigation plan
3: ECS instance
4: full logs
parameters.help_zh:
使用操作对象筛选结果，传入要查询的操作对象的类型。取值：

1：DDoS高防IP
2：DDoS高防抗D包
3：ECS实例
4：全量日志
parameters.name: entity_type

parameters.help_en: The operation object used to filter results
parameters.help_zh: 使用操作对象筛选结果，传入要查询的操作对象
parameters.name: entity_object

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The time range cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

查询时间的跨度不允许超过近30天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

The time range cannot exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：毫秒。

查询时间的跨度不允许超过近30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. For example, to query the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 页面显示的记录数量。最大值：50
parameters.name: page_size
